sentences.en: Don't hesitate to take the opportunity to propose to her.
Here I decide, without hesitating, to take the alternative route.
sentences.zh: 我毫不犹豫地选择了另一条路。

sentences.en: Don't hesitate to ask if you wish to know something!
sentences.zh: 如果你想知道什么就不要犹豫提问！

senses.zh: 犹豫，踌躇，含糊，停顿，口吃，迟疑

mnemonic: 词根记忆：hes（粘附）+itate→脚像粘住了一样→犹豫
